title: Clarify live-region and clipboard announcement behavior for charts and compact controls
creator: Asha Patel
description: Audit and define consistent patterns for screen-reader announcements triggered by clipboard events, chart interactions (legend toggles, point focus), and compact control state changes. This ticket covers: 1) whether clipboard copy/paste feedback should use polite or assertive live regions across products, 2) standardized announcement phrasing for chart legend toggles and series filters, 3) interaction timing and deduplication to avoid announcement floods, and 4) guidance for contrast and focus tone when an announcement is tied to a visual highlight. Deliverables: design spec, example components, a small QA checklist, and annotations for VPAT evidence pack.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec document with patterns for clipboard announcements and chart live regions is approved by accessibility lead
Component examples (legend toggle, point focus, compact pill copy) annotated with aria attributes and example markup
Announce phrasing matrix covering locale fallback, pluralization, and numeric values
Integration notes for engineers including debounce/dedup rules to prevent repeated announcements
VPAT evidence snippets added to design-2026.03 artifacts link
steps: Review existing components using live regions and clipboard messaging across console and embed SDK
Prototype announcement phrasing for 6 common scenarios (copy success/failure, legend on/off, point focus, batch filter applied, paste-received with validation, compact-control toggle)
Create ARIA markup examples and a11y test harness page for QA team
Sync with ENG infra for debounce implementation and for telemetry hooks
Publish spec and update design token guidance for focus contrast when announcements include visual highlights
decisions: Prefer polite live regions for non-critical clipboard feedback unless an operation blocks workflow (e.g., paste validation error) in which case use assertive
Use concise announcement templates with placeholders (e.g., 'Series {name} hidden', 'Copied {n} items') to keep SR output predictable
Introduce a platform-level 500ms dedup window for repeated announcements triggered by rapid UI changes; exact debounce to be implemented by ENG-619001
Visual highlight of announced elements should not rely on color alone; ensure a 3rd focus indicator token (outline or bold state) per token guidance
